title: Saving New Customer creates the customer with the chosen term and limit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Choose a name for the new customer, customer A.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type the name of customer A in Customer Name.
  3. Choose term A in Credit Terms.
  4. Type 800 in Credit Limit.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows term A.

Step 4:

  • Credit Limit reads 800.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the new customer is saved.

Step 6:

  • The "Credit term" reads term A and the credit limit is $800.00.
  • No extra screen was needed to set the term.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R6: “On Save, the customer is created with the chosen term and limit.”
  • Goals: “Creating a customer on a non-default term takes zero extra screens: the term is set on New Customer itself.”
